purpose: Explicit local uncertainty-only source review, followed by current posterior/gradient evaluations; producer manifests are retained.

src/PopulationBalanceModels.jl.review: Adds exports for the Gauss–Newton uncertainty API only; existing forward/posterior includes and definitions unchanged.

src/inference/bayesian_diagnostics.jl.review: Includes new opt-in uncertainty implementation; shares marginal/draw accessors via a type union. Existing posterior gradient and Laplace calculations unchanged; existing Laplace/MCMC draw semantics retained.

src/inference/statistical_model.jl.review: MAPResult docstring only; no likelihood, prior, parameter transformation or prediction change.

ext/PopulationBalanceModelsOptimExt.jl.review: Adds opt-in uncertainty=:gauss_newton after MAP optimization. Default uncertainty=:none, optimizer and statistical target unchanged.

src/inference/gauss_newton.jl.review: New opt-in fixed-Gaussian sensitivity covariance calculation. No forward residual, likelihood, prior, sampler or solver replacement.
